_readme: The hand-built Datadog objects (RC1-378). One entry per object; the file
beside it in dashboards/, monitors/, synthetics/ or slos/ is its export.
Generated objects — the two 'Program KPIs' dashboards, the six KPI
monitors, the seven program SLOs — belong to `python -m kpi.datadog` and
are refused here on purpose: see docs/datadog-as-code.md.
Datadog's own host monitor pack (283790038-45, tag monitor_pack:host) is
installed by the Agent integration, not by us, and is left alone.

dashboards.why: RC1-345 site observability — SLOs, Synthetics, SSL and RUM for hihelloreid.com in one pane
RC1-346 agent fleet — one LLM Observability pane over the five ml_apps
RC1-347 delivery — CI pipelines, deploy events and the DORA group across the four repos
RC1-348 usage & cost — the estate watching its own Datadog bill
